text:
monitoring-bot: ALERT sev2: rising OOM rate on us-west-2 gpu-pool-7 -> 6 OOMs in last 8m. Affected service: inference-runtime (kv-paged allocator). Logs show CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY and container restarts. https://ops.internal/alerts/1748891230

alex: ack, assigning to oncall. pulling logs now.

priya: i'm oncall, i'm in. which nodes are hitting it?

alex: primary is gpu-uw2-07-12 (container runtime-86c9), also sporadic on gpu-uw2-07-14. tailing runtime logs.

lena: seeing repeated: `kvcache: fragment_ratio=0.93 -> paged_alloc failed` and `allocator: slow-grow then OOM` in the same timeframe.

alex: paste logs:
```
[2026-03-16T22:11:02Z] runtime: cuda_alloc failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY size=1.2G
[2026-03-16T22:11:03Z] kvcache: fragment > 92% - paged-alloc cannot satisfy request
[2026-03-16T22:11:04Z] container: oom_killer invoked, restarting container runtime-86c9
```

priya: thanks. customer impact? any 5xx spikes?

alex: yes — ~4% overall requests hit fallback, but for enterprise-us tenant subset it's ~40% failures with 503s for heavy embedding jobs. Latency increases observed for batching paths.

lena: quick mitigation idea: increase eviction aggressiveness and force compaction to reclaim resident fragments. also disable delayed warmup so pages don't get pinned.

priya: steps we can run now?

alex: ops-bot can call eviction API: `POST /allocator/evict?pool=gpu-pool-7&level=aggressive`. then set pool env `KV_EVICT_TARGET=0.75` and toggle `KV_COMPACT_ON_FAIL=1` to force compaction after allocation failure. Finally, roll restart the affected container.

ops-bot: Eviction API called, response 200. Starting eviction sweep on gpu-pool-7.

deploy-bot: Initiating rolling restart of runtime-86c9 on gpu-uw2-07-12 to clear resident fragments.

lena: monitoring fragmentation metrics... fragmentation marker dropping 93% -> 80% within ~3m after eviction.

priya: good. still saw an OOM on gpu-uw2-07-14 a minute ago, recommending cordon+drain if it repeats.

alex: notifying customer-ops: CloudMetrics is impacted, retries placed on their jobs. putting a hold on large batch jobs for that tenant.

lena: quick triage note: found path in paged-attn allocator where many small transient allocations keep slab references alive during compaction, preventing effective reclaim. patch approach: force compaction pass after N failed paged-allocs and drop small-holder refs earlier.

priya: short-term plan: 1) aggressive eviction + compaction flags applied (done) 2) targeted restarts of affected containers (done) 3) cordon extra node if repeats (in progress) 4) monitor 15m. Who owns the long-term fix?

alex: assigning to lena for patch + postmortem. lena will open PR for compaction-on-fail and a small-holder ref-count change. I'll update incident ticket and loop in eng-runtime.

ops-bot: cordon and drain started for gpu-uw2-07-14.

lena: taking it. will open PR and run canary on staging tomorrow morning. planning to include a targeted unit test for small-holder lifecycles.

priya: handoff: i'll be on watch for 2h, then handing to alex for nightwatch. Current status: mitigations applied, fragmentation trending down, no new OOMs on restarted hosts, customer retries in place. severity P1 -> P2.

alex: ack handoff. leaving monitoring alerts and runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv-paged-oom. I'll maintain nightwatch embargo.

deploy-bot: Rolling restarts complete for affected containers. No new OOMs in the last 12m.

monitoring-bot: UPDATE: incident mitigated, alert suppression applied.

priya: closing this active thread for handoff notes — will follow up with timeline and postmortem once PR lands. /me adding details to the incident ticket 1748891230.

lena: note for postmortem: check allocator compaction thresholds, warmup behavior on reserved capacity, and add metric for resident-slab-holders to catch this earlier.

alex: thanks team.
